message.name: MarketClaimStatusAdviceV04
message.definition: Scope and Usage|The MarketClaimStatusAdvice message is sent by an account servicer to an account holder to provide the status of a market claim transaction.|This message definition is intended for use with the Business Application Header (BAH).

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: OfficialCorporateActionEventReferenceGuideline
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the structure and usage of the Official Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF). These recommendations are available in the SMPG Global Market Practices Part 1 document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: The SafekeepingPlace is only to be used by global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.
